newsitem.title: USA: TII surge arrestor to produce revs in 97.
newsitem.headline: TII surge arrestor to produce revs in 97.

text.p: TII Industries Inc said on Tuesday that its in-line coaxial transmission line surge arrestor, which just received a U.S. patent, should begin to produce revenues in fiscal 1997.
The product, which protects coaxial cables from excessive voltage, would make a more material contribution in fiscal 1998, the company said.
The company said there was already considerable commercial interest in the arrestor, and the product was targeted at a market potentially worth $1 billion.
The arrestor was first used commercially to protect video programming links in Atlanta during the Olympic Games coverage, the company said.
TII said coaxial cables are the preferred method of providing high bandwidth signals to business and residential user by regional telephone companies and cable companies.
